<ParamField body="axis" type="&quot;x&quot; | &quot;y&quot;" default="y">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="defaultValue" type="number | (readonly string[] &amp; number)" default="150">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="direction" type="&quot;normal&quot; | &quot;reverse&quot;">
  Physical increasing direction. Omit to follow the horizontal text direction; use `normal` or `reverse` for a fixed physical edge.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Disables resizing and removes the handle from the tab order.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="dragThreshold" type="number" default="0">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="max" type="number" default="500">
  Maximum allowed size.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="min" type="number" default="50">
  Minimum allowed size.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onActivate" type="(() =&gt; void)">
  Called for a click without dragging, Enter, or Space.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onResizeEnd" type="((details: { cancelled: boolean; value: number; }) =&gt; void)">
  Called after a started drag ends, with its latest live value and whether it was cancelled. Cancellation keeps the live value until the caller changes it.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onResizeStart" type="((value: number) =&gt; void)">
  Called once with the first bounded drag value after the threshold is crossed.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onValueChange" type="((value: number) =&gt; void)">
  Called with the bounded size after pointer or keyboard interaction.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onValueCommit" type="((value: number) =&gt; void)">
  Called with the final size after a successful drag or an effective keyboard size change. Cancellation does not commit.

<ParamField body="scale" type="number | (() =&gt; number)" default="1">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="step" type="number" default="10">
